source: NREL/PR-5000-88335, 2022 Cost of Wind Energy Review (2023), pp. 25, 27, 29, 30
reference_layout_rule: Deterministic farthest-point selection on a 1.01*d_min grid inside the original XML allowed region; independent of candidate count M and algorithms
substation_rule: Fixed at (Width/2, 0); scenario assumption, not supplied by WindFLO
parameter_transfer_status: Research benchmark transfer from a 3.3 MW US land-based reference to WindFLO's 1.5 MW turbine, not site-calibrated pricing
explicit_assumptions: Electrical infrastructure budget is scaled linearly by rooted geometric connection length; this scaling is our approximation, not the NREL cost model
The electrical budget is subtracted from total CAPEX before adding the layout-scaled term, avoiding double counting
FCR is used directly; do not multiply by CRF again
Reference financing assumes 25 years; reference source has taxes/depreciation, but these are not separately simulated here
No additional nonwake losses are asserted; AEP already includes the modeled wake loss
No electrical capacity, loss, voltage-drop, road-routing or terrain-engineering feasibility claim
